blurb: Guests fish in the Gulf of America targeting species like red snapper, yellowfin tuna, swordfish, grouper, and more. Trips range from family-friendly nearshore fishing to serious offshore and blue water fishing adventures. The company operates two boats: a 31' Bertram and a 37' Freeman catamaran, captained by licensed professionals.

quotes.text: Capt Chance and Tommy are an awesome team. We have been here 3 years running and they just keep getting better. THEY CAN FIND and CATCH fish. We caught 4 huge snappers, 4 larger redfish, a mackerel and 3 jacks in about 3 hours. The misses were all on us! Great guys, they work very hard, and are just fun to be around. Immaculately clean boat with a clean head. You won’t be disappointed! Somehow even got the weather to cooperate

What an exciting fun filled day we had with Captain Chance and Tommy. We were catching fish when others weren’t getting anything. Clean boat, great customer oriented trip. I cant brag on these guys enough. My 9 year old clear to my mother all went and had a blast and was taken great care of. Will only fish with this boat and crew from now on. Thanks for the memories.

Best charter I have ever used by far. Chance is a great captain and Tommy is a great deckhand. He is very patient with women and children and loves to help people catch fish. And they know where the big fish are for sure. Thank you Mississippi Gulf Coast Fishing Charters for the memories and fresh snapper in the freezer!

We went sight unseen. Coming from Ohio we were hoping we made the right choice and we did! The captain and deck hand were amazing. Many of us suffer from physical disabilities. And we still got the chance the strike the big fish. Never again will I listen to Mountain Music and not laugh. Hope we can come back again!

Fantastic trip for our anniversary! First time fishing out of the gulf, very clean boat with restroom. Captain put us on some massive red snappers quickly. Right before heading back we even hooked on a rare chicken dolphin! Overall great experience and will be booking with them again in the future. 👍🏻

Had the best time on the water with Chance and Tommy! Caught our limit of red snapper and had a great time doing it. They were very knowledgeable of how to put us on the fish. We were getting bites constantly. Highly recommend!
